watch.text: Watch how this learner uses the app.

red.text: When the border is red, the learner just listens, and says nothing.

avec_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says it at the same time as the teacher. Listen to both voices together.

again.text: Again. Together, at the same time.

rep_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says it once, on their own.

point_b.text: and then points, the border turns green, and the learner says the name, on their own.

only.text: The learner only speaks when the border is green.

yourturn.text: Now it's your turn. Speak clearly and loudly.

q_a.text: Now the teacher asks a question, and answers it herself.

q_b.text: When she asks it again, the border turns green, and the learner says only the answer.
